steps.name: apply-and-format-tracked-stage2-files
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = f5f776c4749469e4da6deacbdce621b37ac94ab5; git fetch origin agent-control; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage2/hygiene-v2.py > /tmp/stage2-hygiene.py; .venv/bin/python /tmp/stage2-hygiene.py; .venv/bin/pre-commit run ruff --all-files || true; .venv/bin/pre-commit run ruff-format --all-files || true; .venv/bin/pre-commit run clang-format --all-files || true; .venv/bin/pre-commit run trailing-whitespace --all-files || true; .venv/bin/pre-commit run end-of-file-fixer --all-files || true; .venv/bin/pre-commit run --all-files; git diff --check; git status --short

steps.name: focused-stage2-regression
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; bash scripts/check_schema.sh; .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_mvp_contract_v6.py tests/test_climate_contract_codegen.py -q; cmake -S test/host -B build/host-tests; cmake --build build/host-tests --parallel; ctest --test-dir build/host-tests -R climate_v6_tests --output-on-failure; git diff --check

verify_steps.name: full-stage2-regression-and-publish
verify_steps.command: set -euo pipefail; .venv/bin/pre-commit run --all-files; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -m 'not hardware'; bash scripts/check_schema.sh; cmake -S test/host -B build/host-tests; cmake --build build/host-tests --parallel; ctest --test-dir build/host-tests --output-on-failure; bash scripts/run_clang_tidy_host.sh; git diff --check; if ! git diff --quiet; then git add -- .pre-commit-config.yaml tools/schema/generate_climate_contract.py lib/environment_control/src/climate test/test_climate_v6 tests/test_climate_contract_codegen.py tests/test_mvp_contract_v6.py test/host/CMakeLists.txt scripts/check_schema.sh scripts/run_clang_tidy_host.sh docs/MVP_ENVIRONMENT_CONTROLLER.md; git diff --cached --check; git commit -m 'Harden climate v6 quality gates'; git push origin HEAD:mvp/environment-controller; fi
